steps.title: Define Project Specifications
steps.description: Establish key application credentials, namespace definition, and package name parameters for the Build Diagnostics Utility.

steps.title: Configure Build Settings
steps.description: Set up build.gradle compiling configuration for AGP 8.3.2, SDK Target 34, and Java 8 compatibility.

steps.title: Configure Application Manifest
steps.description: Set up AndroidManifest.xml with accurate namespace attributes, internet access privileges, and the standard launcher Activity registration.

steps.title: Create Reusable Card Drawable Layout
steps.description: Implement a clean card shape background XML drawable to visually separate different diagnostic categories.

steps.title: Create Console Panel UI Drawable
steps.description: Build a dark, terminal-style console panel shape XML drawable for displaying mock system crash diagnostic logs.

steps.title: Create Layout File
steps.description: Set up activity_main.xml as a multi-tab developer diagnostic interface incorporating nested system logs, test buttons, and system metrics panels.

steps.title: Initialize MainActivity Structure
steps.description: Establish class file architecture, package structure, and all diagnostic package imports in MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Implement Navigation Controls
steps.description: Add multi-tab screen state switching methods inside MainActivity to handle tabs dynamically without layout glitches.

steps.title: Implement System Diagnostic Logic
steps.description: Add helper routines to calculate precise system statistics including runtime JVM metrics, memory thresholds, and disk storage.

steps.title: Implement Network Ping Engine
steps.description: Add multi-threaded socket network ping execution routing to securely test live internet connectivity parameters.

steps.title: Implement Exception Sandbox Tester
steps.description: Add trigger routines for common developer errors (NullPointer, Arithmetic, IndexOutOfBound exceptions) and build a stacktrace formatter utility.

steps.title: Building Build Diagnostics Utility
steps.description: Assemble the completed diagnostic suite to verify target platform build capabilities.
